name: fd-leak
title: Descriptor leak
fix_goal: Every descriptor returned by p101_open must reach one successful p101_close on every ownership path.
fix_steps: Find the p101_open call in the fd-leak scenario.
Add cleanup that calls p101_close when the descriptor was acquired.
Set the descriptor to -1 after a successful close so later cleanup cannot reuse it.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm this lab moves from OPEN to FIXED.
lesson: A descriptor opened with p101_open must be closed on every ownership path.
